tools.name: calculate_reconstitution
tools.description: Given a lyophilized vial size, a volume of bacteriostatic water and a target dose, return the resulting concentration, the volume to draw, and the reading on a U-100 insulin syringe. Use for peptide and compounded GLP-1 dosing arithmetic.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search the English blog corpus by keyword and return matching articles with their titles and canonical URLs. Use to find Shotlee coverage of a drug, peptide, side effect or topic.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch the full Markdown source of one article by its slug, as returned by search_articles.
